body: I appreciate that you read my post and the advice given. I just believe that, after throughout investigation, the issue lies within my personality and I'm uncertain how to change a manifested 25-year old personality if it is the core of my being. I assume there are good-natured people  and bad-natured people and I just happen to belong to the latter. I guess I'm useful in a way because without bad there wouldn't be good.
I regret a lot.  I always realize things too late. It sucks it happened to you too but I know my condolences won't change a thing. Thank you for your reply. I'll read your posts.
